caption:
Crypto trades 24/7. Forex runs about 24 hours a day, 5 days a week. The market will never tell you to stop.
Tired trading is emotional trading. Treat the screen like a job with set hours, not something that keeps you up all night.
Pick your trading window, set alerts at your levels, and protect your sleep and your family time.
Be honest: have you ever traded past midnight? Yes or no.

Education only. Not financial advice.
